items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And as a result of the Miles meeting I even ended up making a recording with him, back in the 50s.

ctx.x: Miles Davis. And as a result of the Miles meeting I even ended up making a recording with him, back in the 50s. That was the only one I ever did with Miles. And who else, oh Ben Webster.
